chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazee', who said:
A man asked him about the shade for the Muhrim (person in Ihram) from the harm of rain or sun, and I was listening, so he ordered him to pay the ransom (fidyah) by slaughtering a sheep in Mina.

key_terms.المُحرِم: The pilgrim in the state of Ihram

ai.seo_question: What is the fidyah (ransom) for a Muhrim who uses shade from rain or sun?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Istibsar clarifies the specific fidyah (ransom) for a Muhrim who uses a covering (thilal) for protection against rain or sun, mandating the slaughter of a sheep in Mina. It highlights the practical application of the general principle in Surah Al-Baqarah, distinguishing this specific penalty from other forms of expiation like feeding the poor or fasting, which are also mentioned in the Quranic verse.
